newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sees 1996 rice exports at 5.2 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sees 1996 rice exports at 5.2 mln tonnes.

text.p: A senior commerce ministry official on Wednesday forecast that Thailand's rice exports this year would total 5.2 million tonnes.
The government had earlier this year set a target of 5.0-5.5 million tonnes for exports.

Pracha Charutrakulchai, director-general of the ministry's foreign trade department, said the value of the rice exports was likely to reach 47.3 billion baht ($1.89 billion), exceeding a target of 40 billion baht.
He said Thailand had already exported around 4.79 million tonnes of rice during the January-November period and the outlook for December was robust.
The ministry would soon send an export promotion team to potential buyers such as Japan, China, and Indonesia to secure more orders, he added.
